desc.en: Using a Basic Attack quickly after Reina's Special Skill triggers a bonus attack that pierces through the enemy and deals Lightning DMG. This attack is considered a Basic Attack and generates 2 extra charge(s) of Lightning Energy.

Each Variant Attack's number of Lightning Energy charges consumed decreases by 2. / The effect values of Steel Retaliation are multiplied by 2, and using a 2 or 3-Hit Variant Attack grants Steel Retaliation even when Reina doesn't take a hit. / Using a Variant Attack's 3rd Hit triggers additional lightning strikes to increase the total DMG by 20%.
The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Basic Attack DMG by 6%.
Reina's max HP increases by 10%. / Her Passive Trait is enhanced, increasing the cap of the Neutralization DMG Boost based on Reina's Max HP to 15%.
The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Ultimate Skill DMG by 6%.

Reina's Ultimate Skill DMG increases by 30%. Using Reina's Ultimate Skill immediately generates 6 charges of Lightning Energy and increases her DEF by 30% for 6s. / Also, Reina grants all teammates Celestial Energy upon using her Ultimate Skill or Tag-out Skill. (Duration: 15s) / While Celestial Energy is active, using a Variant Attack's 3rd Hit will generate 4 charge(s) of Lightning Energy. (This effect only triggers once every 15s.)
Reina's Neutralization DMG increases based on her Max HP. / Landing certain attacks or using skills charges her Lightning Energy.
